issue_context.title: Shelly BLU Wall Switch 4 - Unable to create automation for button_[1..4]
issue_context.body:
### The problem

The new Shelly Wall Switch 4 has four buttons, they are titled button_1 through button_4. When trying to create an automation, the trigger with "type: button_1" is rejected during saving, with:
`Message malformed: extra keys not allowed @ data['type']`
Note the UI does insert button_1 thru button_4 into the YAML, but saving is rejected.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2024.8.3

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Shelly

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/shelly

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
trigger:
  - platform: device
    device_id: xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
    domain: bthome
    type: button_1
    subtype: press
    id: b1p1
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

Curiously, when I changed "button_1" to "button" in the YAML, just for testing this issue, I did not receive the above error message during saving, but a "500" instead. Seems like part of the integration knows there are 4 buttons, but another part thinks it's just one button (like the older BLE buttons). Some copy/paste screwup? :-)

> there is no a way to use "subtype" like press, long_press, etc.

You can use `sub_type`/`event_type` with event entity platform

```yaml
trigger:
  - platform: state
    entity_id: event.shelly_blu_rc_button_4_button_1
action:
  - alias: "Choose an action based on the type of event"
    choose:
      - conditions:
        - alias: "Normal evening scene if the button was pressed"
          condition: state
          entity_id: event.shelly_blu_rc_button_4_button_1
          attribute: "event_type"
          state: "press"
        sequence:
          - scene: scene.living_room_evening
      - conditions:
        - alias: "Scene for watching a movie if the button was double-pressed"
          condition: state
          entity_id: event.shelly_blu_rc_button_4_button_1
          attribute: "event_type"
          state: "double_press"
        sequence:
          - scene: scene.living_room_movie
```
